facts.text: King George Hotel dates back to 1930 and sits in the heart of Syntagma Square.
facts.excerpt: King George Hotel dates back to 1930 and sits in the heart of Syntagma Square.

facts.text: The two-bedroom Penthouse Suite has a private outdoor pool with views of the Acropolis and the city from the ninth floor.
facts.excerpt: The palatial two-bedroom Penthouse Suite is primarily distinguished by an expansive private outdoor pool that allows stunning views of the Acropolis and our renowned city from the ninth floor.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite's adjacent terrace has sitting and dining areas.
facts.excerpt: On the adjacent terrace are charming sitting and dining areas.

facts.text: All rooms have oversized windows, hand-picked antiques, classic cornicing, hardwood floors and silk drapes.
facts.excerpt: while all offer oversized windows, hand-picked antiques, classic cornicing, hardwood floors and plush silk drapes

facts.text: Rooms have The Luxury Collection Bed dressed in custom Frette linen.
facts.excerpt: Settle in with The Luxury Collection Bed dressed in custom Frette linen

facts.text: Each room has a marble-lined en-suite bathroom with a rainfall shower, and many have a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Each elegant room includes a marble-lined en-suite bathroom with a rainfall shower, and many offer a bathtub.

facts.text: The suites offer city-center views or overlook the hotel's atrium.
facts.excerpt: Our Athens luxury suites offer city-center views or overlook the hotel

facts.text: Tudor Hall is the hotel's rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar, pairing neo-classical decor with seventh-floor views of the Acropolis.
facts.excerpt: Tudor Hall Restaurant, our rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar in Athens, pairs neo-classical décor with iconic seventh-floor views of the Acropolis.

facts.text: Tudor Hall Restaurant is Michelin-starred.
facts.excerpt: Dine at the Michelin Star-awarded Tudor Hall Restaurant for modern cuisine and incomparable landmark views.

facts.text: At George, The Lobby Bar, signature cocktails crafted around a zero-waste philosophy are prepared tableside.
facts.excerpt: Signature cocktails, inspired by the six senses and crafted around a zero-waste philosophy, are prepared tableside

facts.text: The lobby features Murano chandeliers and bright marbles.
facts.excerpt: the Murano chandeliers, the bright marbles and the finest furnishing are just some of the elegant touch points.

facts.text: The hotel presents a rotating collection of artworks by Greek artists.
facts.excerpt: is a proud Ambassador of the contemporary Greek art scene, by presenting to its cosmopolitan travelers, a rotating collection of artworks from Greek Artists.

facts.text: Paintings by Greek artists such as Pavlos Samios and Kostis Georgiou, and the Golden Olive Trees by Constantinos Valaes, are displayed in the hotel.
facts.excerpt: exclusively curated by renowned Greek artists such as Pavlos Samios and Kostis Georgiou or even the unique Golden Olive Trees by Constantinos Valaes.

facts.text: Visitors can buy the displayed artworks through the artists' representative at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: visitors can also choose to buy through the artists' representative at the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of heritage sites such as the Parthenon, Acropolis Hill, the New Acropolis Museum and the Ancient Agora, and of Plaka and Thission.
facts.excerpt: King George is located within walking distance from the wonders of Athens. This engaging location includes heritage destinations such as the Parthenon, Acropolis Hill, the New Acropolis Museum, and the Ancient Agora

facts.text: Voukourestiou Street, for luxury shopping, is within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: For luxury shopping, Voukourestiou Street is also within walking distance

facts.text: The Monastiraki Flea Market is less than a mile from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the colorful Monastiraki Flea Market, less than a mile from our doors

facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge, Apostolos Papayiannakis, is a bilingual certified destination expert and a Les Clefs d'Or member, available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Our Luxury Collection Concierge, Apostolos Papayiannakis, is a bilingual, certified destination expert proudly wearing the "Les Clefs d’Or,"

facts.text: The concierge team arranges private tours of landmarks such as the New Acropolis Museum, Archaeological Museum, Benaki Museum and Byzantine Museum.
facts.excerpt: In addition to arranging full private tours of historical landmarks, such as the New Acropolis Museum, Archaeological Museum, Benaki Museum, and Byzantine Museum

facts.text: The concierge team can arrange tee times at golf courses in the Glyfada area, about 20 minutes away.
facts.excerpt: The team can also arrange a tee time at any number of golf courses in the Glyfada area, approximately 20 minutes away.

facts.text: Disposable bottles, high chairs and safe bed railings are available on request for children.
facts.excerpt: Disposable bottles, high chairs & safe bed railings are available upon request.

facts.text: Tudor Hall Restaurant and in-room dining offer a children's menu of snacks and meals.
facts.excerpt: An assortment of snacks & meals can be found in the In-room Dining and in Tudor Hall Restaurant children's menu.

facts.text: Luggage Liaison services include luggage storage and unpacking and packing on request.
facts.excerpt: Luggage Liaison, a suite of travel services, also includes luggage storage and unpacking/packing services upon request.

facts.text: The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
facts.excerpt: King George, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Athens does not offer on-site parking.

facts.text: Pets are welcome but allowed in guest rooms only.
facts.excerpt: Please note that pets are allowed in guest rooms only.

facts.text: In-room dining operates 24 hours a day with local and international dishes.
facts.excerpt: Featuring an authentic selection of local and international delicacies, our private dining services operate 24 hours on daily basis.

facts.text: The fitness center is temporarily closed for renovation.
facts.excerpt: Kindly be informed that the Fitness Center is temporarily closed for an exciting renovation.

facts.excerpt: Among the finest of the luxury hotels in Athens, Greece, King George Hotel dates back to 1930
